fields.Name: W8 -> S9.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.40 (phase 2, dataset W8, criterion S9.4): noise columns carry <= 10% of held-out permutation importance on W8-highcard s42 (T8; 87-100% today). The noise columns are Noise1-Noise5, Region, PostalCode and MemberNumber, which is also flagged as a high-cardinality identifier. It fails when importance is computed on training rows (noise share > 10%).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The noise columns of W8-highcard s42 carry at most 10% of the positive held-out permutation importance of a LightGBM run, and MemberNumber is flagged high-cardinality-id (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
